stories.headline: SK Hynix raises $26.5B in largest-ever US IPO by a foreign company

key_facts.fact: SK Hynix priced its Nasdaq offering of 177.9 million American depositary receipts at $149 each on Thursday, July 9, raising about $26.5 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: SK hynix has priced its Nasdaq offering of American depositary receipts at $149 apiece, setting the deal at about $26.5 billion... would offer 177.9 million ADRs, with each receipt representing one-tenth of a common share traded in Seoul.

key_facts.fact: At $26.5 billion the offering surpasses Alibaba's $25 billion 2014 New York listing, making it the largest US IPO by a foreign company and the second-biggest IPO in US market history behind SpaceX's ~$85.7 billion offering.
key_facts.excerpt: the offering would surpass the $25 billion raised by Alibaba in its 2014 New York listing, making it the largest US IPO by a foreign company... the second-biggest IPO in US market history, behind SpaceX's roughly $85.7 billion offering.

key_facts.fact: Demand for the share sale was more than seven times the available shares, priced at a 2.7% premium to SK Hynix's average price over the last three trading days, which the company called the first US IPO of its kind priced at a premium.
key_facts.excerpt: SK Hynix priced the listing at a 2.7% premium over its average share price in the last three trading days... Demand for SK Hynix's U.S. share sale was more than seven times available shares.

key_facts.fact: The ADRs begin trading on the Nasdaq on July 10 under the ticker 'SKHY'; the company's primary listing remains in Seoul, and underwriters are Bank of America, Citigroup, Goldman Sachs and J.P. Morgan.
key_facts.excerpt: The ADRs will start trading on the Nasdaq on July 10. Bank of America, Citigroup, Goldman Sachs and J.P. Morgan are the underwriters. The company's primary listing will remain in Seoul.

key_facts.fact: Proceeds will finance new factories and equipment to meet AI chip demand; SK Hynix is the leading supplier of high-bandwidth memory, and the US listing aims to narrow its valuation gap with rival Micron.
key_facts.excerpt: The offering from the South Korean chipmaker will finance new factories and equipment to meet surging AI chip demand... SK Hynix's U.S. listing is expected to help narrow its valuation gap with U.S. rival Micron.

stories.headline: Micron lifts US investment to $250B and pours first concrete at New York DRAM fab

key_facts.fact: Micron said Thursday, July 9 it will increase planned US investment to more than $250 billion through 2035, up from prior projections, citing AI-driven memory demand.
key_facts.excerpt: Micron Technology Inc. announced Thursday it will increase its planned U.S. investment to more than $250 billion through 2035, up from previous projections, citing demand for memory in artificial intelligence applications.

key_facts.fact: The company completed its first concrete pour at its Clay, New York fab more than a quarter ahead of schedule, marking the transition from site preparation to vertical construction.
key_facts.excerpt: The company completed its first concrete pour at its Clay, New York facility more than one quarter ahead of schedule, marking the transition from site preparation to vertical construction.

key_facts.fact: The expanded investment supports Micron's goal of producing 40% of its DRAM in the US and follows a separate up-to-$3 billion strategic investment to strengthen the domestic semiconductor supply chain.
key_facts.excerpt: The expanded investment supports its goal of producing 40% of its DRAM in the U.S. and follows a separate announcement of up to $3 billion strategic investment to strengthen the domestic semiconductor supply chain.

key_facts.fact: The New York project is the largest private investment in state history and could create up to 50,000 jobs; the site will accommodate up to four fabrication facilities, and broader US plans support more than 90,000 jobs.
key_facts.excerpt: The New York project represents the largest private investment in state history and is expected to generate 50,000 jobs in New York, including 9,000 direct Micron positions... The site will accommodate up to four fabrication facilities.

key_facts.fact: CEO Sanjay Mehrotra tied the move to the AI memory boom: 'data and memory are foundational to the modern economy, and Micron is increasing our U.S. investments to more than $250 billion through 2035 to meet that moment.'
key_facts.excerpt: Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra detailed the company's new $250 billion U.S. investment as the chip-making giant responds to surging demand for memory storage in the age of artificial intelligence.

stories.headline: 1X unveils 25-DoF tendon-driven hands for its Neo humanoid robot

key_facts.fact: On July 9, 1X detailed new hands for its Neo humanoid with 25 degrees of freedom (22 fully actuated in the fingers and palm, plus 3 at the wrist), all natively force-controlled, approaching human-hand dexterity.
key_facts.excerpt: All 25 degrees of freedom (22 fully actuated DoF in the fingers and palm, plus 3 at the wrist) are natively force-controlled and fully...

key_facts.fact: The hands use 1X's Tendon Drive: polymer tendons pulled by in-house motors at quasi-direct-drive ratios of roughly 5:1 to 15:1, giving force transparency so the hand can both exert and sense force through the same joints.
key_facts.excerpt: Everything is driven by the company's Tendon Drive: polymer tendons pulled by 1X's own motors at quasi-direct-drive ratios of roughly 5:1 to 15:1.

key_facts.fact: A functional tactile skin, co-designed with the sensors and tendons, measures normal force, contact location and shear, letting Neo detect slipping objects and handle fragile items like origami without damage.
key_facts.excerpt: This skin measures normal force, contact location, and shear, enabling NEO to detect slipping objects or handle fragile items like origami without damage.

key_facts.fact: Neo is 1X's home humanoid platform, weighing 66 pounds yet capable of lifting over 150 pounds; the hands are pitched as 'an API to the physical world' for embodied AI.
key_facts.excerpt: NEO represents a generational leap in humanoid hardware with the addition of Human Level Dexterity... At just 66 pounds, NEO is capable of lifting over 150 pounds.

stories.headline: EQT to buy Carlyle's Copia Power data-center energy platform for $2.6B

key_facts.fact: EQT Infrastructure agreed to acquire Copia Power, a US integrated power and AI infrastructure platform, from Carlyle at an equity valuation of about $2.6 billion, announced July 9.
key_facts.excerpt: EQT Infrastructure acquires Carlyle's Copia Power in $2.6bn deal

key_facts.fact: The sale hands Carlyle more than a fivefold return on its initial investment, amid a boom in AI data-center build-out deals.
key_facts.excerpt: Carlyle is set to make a more than fivefold return from the $2.6bn sale of a data centre power and infrastructure platform to EQT, amid a boom...

key_facts.fact: Copia controls 2.6 gigawatts of operational or under-construction assets, 20GW in development, and 9GW aimed at supplying southeastern and Midwest US data-center campuses.
key_facts.excerpt: Copia Power controls 2.6GW of operational or under-construction assets, 20GW in development, and 9GW aimed at supplying southeastern and Midwest U.S. data centre campuses.

key_facts.fact: Copia was created in 2021 by Carlyle's infrastructure group and develops data-center campuses by acquiring land and linking sites to renewable power; EQT is buying it to offer tech firms a broader AI-infrastructure solution.
key_facts.excerpt: Copia was created in 2021 by Carlyle's infrastructure group and develops data centre campuses across the southwestern U.S. by acquiring land and linking sites to renewable power sources.

stories.headline: Nanya posts record Q2 on DRAM shortage, plans $6.2B capex for 2027

key_facts.fact: At its July 10 investor conference, Nanya Technology reported second-quarter 2026 revenue of NT$82.55 billion (about $2.6 billion), up 684% year-over-year and 68% quarter-over-quarter, a historic high.
key_facts.excerpt: Second-quarter revenue totaled NT$82.55 billion (approximately $2.6 billion), up 68.17% quarter-over-quarter and 684.23% year-over-year.

key_facts.fact: Nanya's Q2 gross margin topped 79%, exceeding TSMC's, delivering a single-quarter profit of NT$50.19 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Nanya Technology's Q2 Gross Margin Soars Past 79%, Trouncing TSMC, with a Single-Quarter Profit Windfall of NT$50.19 Billion

key_facts.fact: The DRAM maker plans 2027 capital spending of more than NT$200 billion (about $6.2 billion), roughly four times its 2026 outlay, to accelerate new fab construction for AI-led memory demand.
key_facts.excerpt: Nanya Bets Big on AI With $6.2 Billion Semiconductor Investment for 2027

key_facts.fact: First-half 2026 revenue reached NT$131.64 billion (about $4.1 billion), up 643% year-over-year, with June revenue of NT$29.39 billion, up 621% year-over-year and a monthly record.
key_facts.excerpt: Cumulative first-half revenue reached NT$131.64 billion (approximately $4.1 billion), up 643.12% year-over-year... Nanya's June consolidated revenue reached NT$29.39 billion, up 6.21% month-over-month and surging 621.34% year-over-year.

key_facts.fact: Nanya's surge is driven by a DDR4 supply shortage as the three big memory makers shift capacity to HBM and DDR5, boosting Nanya's pricing power as a leading DDR4 supplier.
key_facts.excerpt: the three major global memory manufacturers have been consistently shifting capacity toward high-end products such as HBM and DDR5... This has positioned Nanya Technology as one of the primary DDR4 suppliers, significantly enhancing its pricing power.
